q1._comment: Clerk's Margin Note. Driven by sim/quests_q1/clerk_note.gd. Debt cut is capped by design (owner rule).

clause.title: Margin note
clause.text: Clause 14(c): interest accrues on the debtor. Not the debt.

offer.text: {clerk} has found a loophole. It involves a pencil and a short memory.

options.label: Use the loophole
options.hint: Cuts debt (capped). Audit parts +20% for 12 days. Clerk may vanish.

options.label: Report the Clerk
options.hint: Refined essence allowance. Clerk may escape.

notice_loophole.title: Warden notice
notice_loophole.text: A discrepancy has been located. It was not hidden well.

payoff_loophole.title: Reassignment
payoff_loophole.text: {clerk} has been reassigned. The ledger has not.

payoff_loophole_kept.title: Clerical note
payoff_loophole_kept.text: {clerk} has been reminded of the pencil. The pencil remains.

payoff_report.title: Allowance
payoff_report.text: The Warden thanks you for your vigilance. Refined essence enclosed.

payoff_report_escape.title: Absence
payoff_report_escape.text: {clerk} has left the premises. This was not approved.

clue.title: Overheard
clue.text: {clerk} mutters: 'Interest on the debtor. They never wrote who owns the debtor.'
